# taxize

[![Project Status: Active – The project has reached a stable, usable
state and is being actively
developed.](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#active)
[![rworkflows](https://github.com/ropensci/taxize/workflows/rworkflows/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/taxize/actions/)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/ropensci/taxize/branch/master/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/ropensci/taxize)
[![rstudio mirror
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/taxize)](https://github.com/r-hub/cranlogs.app)
[![cran
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/taxize)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=taxize)

`taxize` allows users to search over many taxonomic data sources for
species names (scientific and common) and download up and downstream
taxonomic hierarchical information - among other things.

Package documentation: <https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/>

## Installation

### Stable version from CRAN

``` r

install.packages("taxize")
```

### Development version from GitHub

Windows users install Rtools first.

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ropensci/taxize")
```

``` r

library('taxize')
```

# Package index

  : Defunct functions in taxize
- [`taxize_cite()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/taxize_cite.md)
  : Get citations and licenses for data sources used in taxize

  : taxize parameters

## Authentication

- [`taxize-authentication`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/taxize-authentication.md)
  [`authentication`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/taxize-authentication.md)
  : taxize authentication

  Function to get API key.
- [`use_tropicos()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/key_helpers.md)
  [`use_entrez()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/key_helpers.md)
  [`use_iucn()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/key_helpers.md)
  : Helpers to set up authentication for the different providers.

## High level functions

Functions that work across sources

- [`children()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/children.md)
  : Retrieve immediate children taxa for a given taxon name or ID.
- [`classification()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/classification.md)
  [`cbind(`*`<classification>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/classification.md)
  [`rbind(`*`<classification>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/classification.md)
  [`cbind(`*`<classification_ids>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/classification.md)
  [`rbind(`*`<classification_ids>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/classification.md)
  : Retrieve the taxonomic hierarchy for a given taxon ID.
- [`downstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/downstream.md)
  : Retrieve the downstream taxa for a given taxon name or ID.
- [`upstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/upstream.md)
  : Retrieve the upstream taxa for a given taxon name or ID.
- [`comm2sci()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/comm2sci.md)
  : Get scientific names from common names.
- [`sci2comm()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/sci2comm.md)
  : Get common names from scientific names.
- [`id2name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/id2name.md) :
  Taxonomic IDs to taxonomic names
- [`lowest_common()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/lowest_common.md)
  : Retrieve the lowest common taxon and rank for a given taxon name or
  ID
- [`resolve()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/resolve.md) :
  Resolve names from different data sources
- [`synonyms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/synonyms.md)
  [`synonyms_df()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/synonyms.md)
  : Retrieve synonyms from various sources given input taxonomic names
  or identifiers
- [`tax_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tax_name.md)
  : Get taxonomic names for a given rank
- [`tax_rank()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tax_rank.md)
  : Get rank for a given taxonomic name.

  : Get HTTP status codes

  Details on `get_*()` functions

  Last taxon state object from a `get_*` function call

- [`get_boldid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_boldid.md)

  [`get_boldid_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_boldid.md)
  : Get the BOLD (Barcode of Life) code for a search term.

- [`get_eolid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_eolid.md)
  [`as.eolid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_eolid.md)

  [`get_ids_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_ids.md)

  [`get_tsn_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_tsn.md)

- [`get_uid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_uid.md)
  [`as.uid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_uid.md)

  [`get_uid_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_uid.md)

- [`get_wiki()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_wiki.md)
  [`as.wiki()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/get_wiki.md)

## Datasets

- [`apg_families`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg_families.md)
  : MOBOT family names
- [`apg_orders`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg_orders.md)
  : MOBOT order names
- [`plantGenusNames`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/plantGenusNames.md)
  : Vector of plant genus names from ThePlantList
- [`plantNames`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/plantNames.md)
  : Vector of plant species (genus - specific epithet) names from
  ThePlantList
- [`rank_ref`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/rank_ref.md) :
  Lookup-table for IDs of taxonomic ranks
- [`rank_ref_zoo`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/rank_ref_zoo.md)
  : Lookup-table for IDs of taxonomic ranks (WoRMS)
- [`worrms_ranks`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/worrms_ranks.md)
  : WORMS ranks
- [`species_plantarum_binomials`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/species_plantarum_binomials.md)
  : Species names from Species Plantarum
- [`theplantlist`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/theplantlist.md)
  : Lookup-table for family, genus, and species names for ThePlantList

## Random names

- [`names_list()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/names_list.md)
  : Get a random vector of species names.

## Name Resolution Services

- [`gni_details()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gni_details.md)
  : Search for taxonomic name details using the Global Names Index
- [`gnr_datasources()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gnr_datasources.md)
  : Global Names Resolver Data Sources
- [`gnr_resolve()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gnr_resolve.md)
  : Resolve names using Global Names Resolver
- [`iplant_resolve()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/iplant_resolve.md)
  : iPlant name resolution
- [`tol_resolve()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tol_resolve.md)
  : Resolve names using Open Tree of Life (OTL) resolver
- [`gna_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gna_search.md)
  : Search for taxonomic names using the Global Names Architecture
- [`gna_data_sources()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gna_data_sources.md)
  : Get metadata about GNA data sources

## Name Parsers

- [`gni_parse()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gni_parse.md)
  : Parse scientific names using EOL's name parser.
- [`gbif_parse()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gbif_parse.md)
  : Parse taxon names using the GBIF name parser.
- [`gna_verifier()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gna_verifier.md)
  : Verify a list of scientific names against biodiversity data-sources.
- [`gna_parse()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gna_parse.md)
  : Parse scientific names using Global Names Parser

## NCBI Taxonomy

- [`ncbi_children()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/ncbi_children.md)
  : Search NCBI for children of a taxon
- [`ncbi_downstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/ncbi_downstream.md)
  : Retrieve all taxa names downstream in hierarchy for NCBI
- [`ncbi_get_taxon_summary()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/ncbi_get_taxon_summary.md)
  : NCBI taxon information from uids
- [`genbank2uid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/genbank2uid.md)
  : Get NCBI taxonomy UID from GenBankID

## Catalogue of Life

## Global Biodiversity Information Facility

- [`gbif_downstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gbif_downstream.md)
  : Retrieve all taxonomic names downstream in hierarchy for GBIF
- [`gbif_name_usage()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gbif_name_usage.md)
  : Lookup details for specific names in all taxonomies in GBIF.
- [`gbif_parse()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/gbif_parse.md)
  : Parse taxon names using the GBIF name parser.
- [`scrapenames()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/scrapenames.md)
  : Find taxon names using Global Names Recognition and Discovery

## Encyclopedia of Life

- [`eol_dataobjects()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eol_dataobjects.md)
  : Given the identifier for a data object, return all metadata about
  the object
- [`eol_pages()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eol_pages.md)
  : Search for pages in EOL database using a taxonconceptID.
- [`eol_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eol_search.md)
  : Search for terms in EOL database.

## EUBON

- [`eubon_capabilities()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eubon_capabilities.md)
  : EUBON capabilities
- [`eubon_children()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eubon_children.md)
  : EUBON children
- [`eubon_hierarchy()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eubon_hierarchy.md)
  : EUBON hierarchy
- [`eubon_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/eubon_search.md)
  : EUBON taxonomy search

## Index Fungorum

- [`fg_name_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  [`fg_author_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  [`fg_epithet_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  [`fg_name_by_key()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  [`fg_name_full_by_lsid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  [`fg_all_updated_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  [`fg_deprecated_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/fungorum.md)
  : Index Fungorum

## Integrated Taxonomic Information Service

- [`itis_acceptname()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_acceptname.md)
  : Retrieve accepted TSN and name
- [`itis_downstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_downstream.md)
  : Retrieve all taxa names or TSNs downstream in hierarchy from given
  TSN.
- [`itis_getrecord()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_getrecord.md)
  : Get full ITIS record for one or more ITIS TSN's or lsid's.
- [`itis_hierarchy()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_hierarchy.md)
  : ITIS hierarchy
- [`itis_kingdomnames()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_kingdomnames.md)
  : Get kingdom names
- [`itis_lsid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_lsid.md)
  : Get TSN from LSID
- [`itis_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_name-deprecated.md)
  : Get taxonomic names for a given taxonomic name query.
- [`itis_native()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_native.md)
  : Get jurisdiction data, i.e., native or not native in a region.
- [`itis_refs()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_refs.md)
  : Get references related to a ITIS TSN.
- [`itis_taxrank()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_taxrank.md)
  : Retrieve taxonomic rank name from given TSN.
- [`itis_terms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/itis_terms.md)
  : Get ITIS terms, i.e., tsn's, authors, common names, and scientific
  names.

## UK National Biodiversity Network

- [`nbn_classification()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/nbn_classification.md)
  : Search UK National Biodiversity Network database for taxonomic
  classification
- [`nbn_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/nbn_search.md)
  : Search UK National Biodiversity Network
- [`nbn_synonyms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/nbn_synonyms.md)
  : Return all synonyms for a taxon name with a given id from NBN

## Tropicos

- [`tp_accnames()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tp_accnames.md)
  : Return all accepted names for a taxon name with a given id.
- [`tp_dist()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tp_dist.md) :
  Return all distribution records for for a taxon name with a given id.
- [`tp_refs()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tp_refs.md) :
  Return all reference records for for a taxon name with a given id.
- [`tp_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tp_search.md)
  : Search Tropicos by scientific name, common name, or Tropicos ID.
- [`tp_summary()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tp_summary.md)
  : Return summary data a taxon name with a given id.
- [`tp_synonyms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tp_synonyms.md)
  : Return all synonyms for a taxon name with a given id.

## The Plant List

- [`tpl_families()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tpl_families.md)
  : Get The Plant List families.
- [`tpl_get()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tpl_get.md) :
  Get The Plant List csv files.
- [`tpl_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tpl_search-defunct.md)
  : A light wrapper around the taxonstand fxn to call Theplantlist.org
  database.

## Kew’s Plants of the World

- [`pow_lookup()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/pow_lookup.md)
  : Lookup taxa in Kew's Plants of the World
- [`pow_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/pow_search.md)
  : Search Kew's Plants of the World
- [`pow_synonyms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/pow_synonyms.md)
  : Lookup synonyms in Kew's Plants of the World

## IUCN

- [`iucn_getname()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/iucn_getname.md)
  : Get any matching IUCN species names

- [`iucn_id()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/iucn_id.md) :
  Get an ID for a IUCN listed taxon

- [`iucn_status()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/iucn_status.md)
  :

  Extractor functions for `iucn`-class.

- [`iucn_summary()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/iucn_summary.md)
  : Get a summary from the IUCN Red List

## Angiosperm Phylogeny Group

- [`apgOrders()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg.md)
  [`apgFamilies()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg.md) :
  Get APG names
- [`apg_families`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg_families.md)
  : MOBOT family names
- [`apg_lookup()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg_lookup.md)
  : Lookup in the APGIII taxonomy and replace family names
- [`apg_orders`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/apg_orders.md)
  : MOBOT order names

## Other data sources

- [`bold_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/bold_search.md)
  : Search Barcode of Life for taxonomic IDs
- [`bold_downstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/bold_downstream.md)
  : Retrieve all taxa names downstream in hierarchy for BOLD
- [`ion()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/ion.md) : ION -
  Index to Organism Names
- [`ipni_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/ipni_search.md)
  : Search for names in the International Plant Names Index (IPNI).
- [`plantminer()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/plantminer.md)
  : Search for taxonomy data from Plantminer.com
- [`vascan_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/vascan_search.md)
  : Search the CANADENSYS Vascan API.
- [`worms_downstream()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/worms_downstream.md)
  : Retrieve all taxa names downstream in hierarchy for WORMS

## Utilities

- [`class2tree()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/class2tree.md)
  [`plot(`*`<classtree>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/class2tree.md)
  [`print(`*`<classtree>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/class2tree.md)
  : Convert a list of classifications to a tree.
- [`rankagg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/rankagg.md) :
  Aggregate data by given taxonomic rank
- [`tax_agg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tax_agg.md)
  [`print(`*`<tax_agg>`*`)`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tax_agg.md)
  : Aggregate species data to given taxonomic rank
- [`taxize_capwords()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/taxize_capwords.md)
  : Capitalize the first letter of a character string.

## Defunct methods

- [`taxize-defunct`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/taxize-defunct.md)
  [`defunct`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/taxize-defunct.md)
  : Defunct functions in taxize

  : uBio ping
- [`tnrs()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tnrs-defunct.md)
  : Phylotastic Taxonomic Name Resolution Service.
- [`tnrs_sources()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/taxize/reference/tnrs_sources-defunct.md)
  : TNRS sources
